Description: Advance Retail Sales: Retail Trade (retail sales excluding food services)
Source: FRED / ALFRED (pinned vintages; U.S. Census Bureau, Advance Monthly Retail Trade Survey)
Known Quirks: Trending nominal level, so the signals are growth rates; the advance estimate is first printed about two weeks after month-end and revised in the next two monthly reports and in annual benchmark revisions; extreme 2020-21 swings
Display Note: Nominal, not inflation-adjusted. Excludes food services (restaurants and bars).
Used as the equity-market target and benchmark.
